Hero.statement: I build scalable web products across frontend and backend.
Hero.description: 5+ years building production web applications, scalable frontend architectures and backend APIs. Comfortable across the stack, with a focus on maintainability and long-term scalability.

cashtracker.description: A personal finance app being built to organize monthly income and expenses, including fixed and variable income and recurring costs.

popcornTime.description: A personal project for organizing movies and TV shows to watch, with collections and sharing features planned.

EngineeringStories.heading: Engineering Stories
EngineeringStories.intro: A selection of engineering problems I've worked on in production systems.

stateManagement.title: Scaling Frontend State Management
stateManagement.description: As frontend state grew more complex, I traced unnecessary re-renders to the existing approach. I proposed centralized state with Redux Toolkit, validated it through an MVP, and helped the team adopt the approved approach.

advertisingFeatures.title: Building Flexible Advertising Features
advertisingFeatures.description: I worked across frontend and backend on advertising features involving multiple assets, extending data structures and API behavior where needed. I also built reusable React hooks for asset handling and shared tracking logic.
advertisingFeatures.focus: Full Stack · API Design · Reusable React Patterns

productionReliability.title: Production Debugging & System Reliability
productionReliability.description: I investigated an intermittent production issue linked to a scheduled background job. Inconsistent database values could trigger unhandled API errors; I traced the cause and implemented a permanent fix.

About.heading: Background & Philosophy
About.background: I'm a Full Stack Engineer based in Lima, Peru, with 5+ years of experience building production web products. My work spans frontend architecture, APIs, and backend services, with a particular interest in scalable frontend systems and reusable foundations.
About.philosophy: I care about software that remains understandable and maintainable as products grow. I value clear abstractions, reusable solutions, and engineering decisions that avoid unnecessary complexity.
